method: Candidate bow-tie retrieval aligned to CGE/Wolters Kluwer and CCPS-EI terminology. It classifies wording in the incident record, not source material. All relationships require analyst review against a cited source before use as a finding. Only what_went_wrong statements are used for candidate threats, failed/absent barriers and escalation factors. Lessons and actions are excluded. Explicitly uncertain statements are excluded where recognised.
rule: Candidate top event = first recognised loss-of-control phrase in the chronological record narrative; absence of a phrase is reported as undetermined, not inferred.
